title: phenoscapR: Read, Analyse, and Visualise Single-Cell Spatial Biology Data
description: Tools for importing, processing, analysing, and visualising single-cell spatial biology data from multiplexed imaging platforms. Supports cell-table quality control, marker normalisation, phenotype summaries, spatial neighbourhood statistics, and explicit sample and coordinate-frame registries. Patient-level inference enumerates label allocations for declared contrasts and retains unavailable hypotheses when adjusting for multiple testing. Grouped summaries expose missingness, eligibility, and denominator provenance. Optional canonical cell-table import uses 'cellspecR' https://github.com/CTTIR/cellspecR; optional Self-Organising Nebulous Growths embeddings use 'songR' https://github.com/CTTIR/songR. Both optional packages are available from the CTTIR R-universe, https://cttir.r-universe.dev.
notes: Release candidate metadata. Not yet published.
